inquiries_or_to_report_an_issue: If you would like to know more about how Skin Analytics can help you and your dermatology team deliver best in class dermatology, get in touch via the website.
regulatory_approval_status_if_applicable: Skin Analytics' DERM is a Class III CE marked AI as a Medical Device (AIaMD) [1].
summary: Skin Analytics' DERM (Deep Ensemble for the Recognition of Malignancy) is an AI as a Medical Device (AIaMD) built around a custom teledermatology platform designed to triage patients and conserve dermatologist capacity, and is deployed in the NHS.
keywords: skin cancer; teledermatology; artificial intelligence; triage
intended_use_and_workflow: DERM is intended to triage patients into the right place at the right time, conserving dermatologist capacity. It safely triages patients with non-cancerous lesions away from cancer pathways, allowing dermatologists to focus on patients that need them most. It can be used in NHS Primary and Secondary Care.
primary_intended_users: Dermatologists, dermatology teams, and healthcare professionals in primary and secondary care settings.
targeted_patient_population: Patients referred for dermatology assessment, specifically those with suspected skin lesions.
outcomes_and_output: Triages patients into the right place at the right time, conserves dermatologist capacity, avoids urgent suspected cancer referrals and face-to-face USCRs.
type_and_value_of_solution_output: Triage of patients with non-cancerous lesions away from cancer pathways, allowing dermatologists to focus on the patients that need them most.
